sections.content: Arrays (or lists) store ordered collections under one name. You reach items by position — index 0 is the first element.
Lists grow and shrink dynamically in most languages; fixed arrays exist too. Common operations: add, remove, access by index, and loop through every item.
Key points: indexes start at 0, going past the end crashes or returns nothing, and loops over lists are everywhere in real code.

sections.codeExample:
items = ["a", "b", "c"]
echo items[0]  # first item
# items[1], items[2] ... indexes count from 0
